create_mochi_video_pipeline: create a MochiPipeline instance for text-to-video generation with T5 encoder and VAE decoder
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with attention masks for video generation
denoise_video_latents: run the diffusion denoising loop with classifier-free guidance to generate video latents from noise
decode_latents_to_video: decode denoised video latents through the VAE and postprocess into final video frames
schedule_timesteps: generate linear-quadratic noise schedule timesteps for the flow-matching Euler discrete scheduler
